title: Moscow Yaroslavsky railway station

buildingCutout.basis: Complete individual Yaroslavsky passenger-terminal exterior: the whole named historic front headhouse and connected modern rear concourse, the entire mapped comb-shaped rear boarding canopy and each physically connected mapped passenger platform. Preserve the independent Leningradsky terminal and its many detailed mapped facade parts to the west, Kazansky terminal across the square, postal/rail service properties, streets and rail network. The candidate reference coordinate is in the northern yard; the named passenger-terminal footprint supplies the model anchor. No trains, people, branding, lettering, ticket interfaces or navigable railway interiors. No imagined future shared canopy between the independent terminals. Standard 20261031 PMTiles physically associates the named Yaroslavsky Rail Terminal building/POI 52776559531195 with its complete two tile fragments and rear canopy 52776559531169. The ordinary front photo resolves asymmetric left spire, large eastern flared/tented roof, right turret, broad arched entry, grey-brown walls, pale trim and turquoise ceramic frieze. A 2026 yard picture establishes the open platform/track character but does not verify hidden terminal facades. Native main envelope height14m and rear canopy5m are retained as map facts; feature-specific roof/tower heights, wall bays, hidden facade details, floor/platform grades and current renovation state are explicit medium-fi estimates. Source hall and platform floors are +1.25m from one unchanged standard outside forecourt sample [10,69], 149.02778940000002m absolute datum. The native main envelope14m and boarding canopy5m are retained; western shaft19m/drum23.2m/spire42m/finial44.55m, broad eastern flared roof30.2m/crest32.7m and right turret26m are explicit picture-based estimates. Eight whole mapped platform islands are retained; a fixed transverse concrete boarding apron connects their noses to the rear canopy, without masking the rail corridor. Exact threshold, track-buffer and platform grades remain unverified.

groundCutout.basis: Only the actual closed passenger-terminal hall floor union. The rear boarding canopy, transverse apron, all eight open platforms, rail corridors, streets and independent buildings receive no blanket ground opening.
